caption: The drawing shows a wooden object composed of several distinct parts. The main structure is vertically oriented, consisting of a broad, flat wooden board with a rectangular upper section and a curvilinear, symmetrically shaped lower section. The upper section has evenly spaced, thin vertical grooves or tines that span the width of the board, resembling teeth of a comb. The lower section is smoothly contoured with inward curves on both sides. The entire board is attached perpendicularly to a thick, roughly rectangular wooden base with visible wood grain and rounded edges. This base has three short, sturdy legs protruding from the bottom, giving the object stability and elevating it off the surface. The colors in the drawing are predominantly shades of brown and beige, highlighting the texture and natural patterns of the wood. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or markings except for a few small dark spots on the left.
title: Hand Loom
